name: Reaction-diffusion
doc: Gray-Scott reaction-diffusion stepped several times per tick on a ping-pong cell grid, streaming slowly outward and turning. Bass pushes feed/kill from mitosis spots toward coral and speeds the drift; onsets seed new spots; the B concentration is coloured through the palette with embossed relief. Fed a picture (in, luma, edges from core-media) it grows from the picture's contours instead, coral on its bright areas and spots on its dark ones, regrows from the contours at every phrase start, and shows the picture lit through the embossed pattern.

palette.doc: stop 0 is the background tint, the last stop the highlights

in.doc: media path (with luma and edges): the picture, lit through the pattern (core-media.out)

luma.doc: media path: the regime follows the picture's brightness, bright = coral (core-media.luma)

edges.doc: media path: the picture's contours seed the reaction (core-media.edges)

cells.doc: sim grid height in cells (width follows the aspect)

spread.doc: how much the regime varies across the screen (outer ring more coral)

drive.doc: how far the bass pushes toward coral

seeds.doc: size of the spots each onset drops (0 = none)

drift.doc: outward stream per tick (bass speeds it up)

swirl.doc: turn per tick, strongest at the centre

edge_seed.doc: media path: how hard the contours seed (a trickle always, a stamp on each onset)

threshold.doc: media path: edge strength that seeds

luma_map.doc: media path: how far the picture's brightness moves the regime (negative = dark areas coral)

reform.doc: media path: how much of the pattern each phrase start wipes, so it regrows from the contours

show.doc: media path: the bare picture between the pattern

picture.doc: media path: the pattern takes the picture's colours (0 = the palette's)

changelog.note: optional media path: in/luma/edges inputs (edge-seeded, luma-mapped regime, phrase wipe, picture lit through the pattern) and its params; unchanged when they are not wired
